description.value:
A powerful punch in a small package, Pride was Rogue's weapon of choice in her youth. The pistol boasts a sleek style and pure lethality in the right hands — especially those of a daring Solo. With Pride, Rogue was able to blaze her path to the top of Night City's mercs, but nowadays she uses words more often than bullets. Even then, it’s still a monument to pistols everywhere.

Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: N/A (Cannot be fabricated, must be gifted or scavenged from Rogue Amendiares)

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 10 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Pistol Long Barrel, TUp (Does not require Interface Plugs or Subdermal Grip) Smartgun Link • Mods: None

Special Features: Despite being Iconic, this weapon may load Non-Basic Ammunition. All ammunition fired by this weapon also functions as Armor-Piercing Ammunition. This weapon can make Aimed Shots at ROF 2. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6), or 2d6 additional damage (5d6) if the user is not in the Seriously or Mortally Wounded Wound State. The first time this weapon rolls for damage during a combat encounter, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries. The first time this weapon’s magazine is emptied during a combat encounter, the user can roll 1d6 against their LUCK, needing to get under their current — not total — LUCK pool. On success, half of this weapon’s magazine is refilled for free.

Fabrication: N/A (Cannot be fabricated, must be gifted or scavenged from Rogue Amendiares)
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Pistol Long Barrel, TUp (Does not require Interface Plugs or Subdermal Grip) Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
